test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) He took his towel and entered the shower.
(2) He cleaned up using shampoo and soap.
(3) He dried and dressed himself up for work.
(4) He regulated the water temperature to suit himself.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph describes a sequence of actions related to a daily routine — taking a shower and getting ready for work. 
 
• **Sentence 1** introduces the process as the person takes their towel and enters the shower. 
 
• **Sentence 4** follows, where the individual regulates the water temperature to suit themselves before proceeding further. 
 
• **Sentence 2** comes next, as the person cleans up using shampoo and soap. 
 
• **Sentence 3** concludes the sequence, as the person dries off and dresses up for work. 
 
• The correct sequence is **1 - 4 - 2 - 3**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"He took his towel and entered the shower. He regulated the water temperature to suit himself. He cleaned up using shampoo and soap. He dried and dressed himself up for work."
